profile.headline: Software Engineer at Nelo
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Currently at Nelo, I am a Tech Lead and Engineer with a track record of spearheading technological innovations. At Buf Technologies, I led key projects like 'proto-gen-validate' and developed 'prototransform' and 'protovalidate', playing a pivotal role in the open-source community. At ANZ Plus, I specialized in advanced card management solutions, demonstrating my Go microservices expertise. My approach focuses on blending technical acumen with community engagement, consistently aiming to foster innovation and collaborative success.

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
My hands-on approach to open-source community building, coupled with my commitment to maintaining high-quality standards, has positioned me as a trusted figure in both product development and community engagement. My accomplishments include:

- Successfully migrating 'proto-gen-validate' from the envoyproxy team to bufbuild organization while cultivating an active open source community.
  
- Directing the development of 'prototransform', gathering feedback from the developer community, and refining based on real-world applications.
  
- Leading the design and implementation of 'protovalidate' in Go, Java, Python, and C++, all while nurturing developer relationships to ensure optimum code quality.

- Seamlessly integrating developer relations in every project phase, organizing community events, encouraging open-source contributions, and fostering a collaborative environment.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
At ANZ Plus, the comprehensive management of the design and implementation of card management functions was seen through a series of bespoke Go microservices, spanning from ideation to final delivery. As part of this extensive initiative, the following features were delivered:

- Capability to lock and unlock cards.
- Advanced controls for physical cards encompassing aspects such as ATM, online, and international usage. A noteworthy industry-first inclusion was the gambling block with impulse protection.
- Provision of digital card details within the app.
- Thorough card lifecycle management.
- Real-time card delivery tracking.
- Seamless provisioning for both Apple Pay and Google Pay.

In addition, a strategic relationship with partners like Visa was fostered, culminating in the crafting of a forward-thinking contract with the Visa Developer Portal APIs. This collaboration is expected to stand ANZ in good stead for many years.

projects.title: ANZ Plus
projects.description: ANZ Plus represents a leap forward in digital banking, offering customers a seamless, integrated experience. At the heart of this initiative was the card management system, a key component I had the privilege of leading. Under my stewardship, we introduced an array of card features that put users firmly in control. From the ability to lock/unlock cards on-the-go to fine-grained controls that cater to diverse user needs, the card management functions stand as a testament to innovation. A highlight was the integration of an industry-first gambling block with impulse protection. Additionally, our work fostered pivotal relationships, most notably with Visa, setting the groundwork for ANZ's digital future with features like Apple Pay and Google Pay provisioning.

projects.title: protovalidate
projects.description: "Protovalidate" is a comprehensive tool designed to validate protocol buffer definitions. Developed across multiple programming languages including Go, Java, Python, and C++, it ensures consistent and error-free protocol messages. By analyzing and cross-checking data structures, "Protovalidate" guarantees data integrity and streamlines the development process. Its implementation has led to reduced code anomalies, increased efficiency, and has set a standard for protocol buffer validation in the industry.
